analysis: Batch 1.2 - law 677 at order 12. Each of the 57 hard cases of EXP-C05-11 (CNF hashes re-checked) was split by right cancellation. All 57 quasigroup parts are UNSAT with drat-trim-verified proofs (at most 276,023 conflicts, 13.2 million proof lines), so with EXP-C05-11 law 677 has no quasigroup model of order 12. Of the 57 non-quasigroup parts (triage budget 1,000,000 conflicts) 6 are refuted with verified proofs - exactly the hard non-idempotent cases whose row 0 has two fixed points - and 51 remain open (14 idempotent, 37 non-idempotent with at most one fixed point in row 0); no model. H-C05-K confirmed.
assumptions: Lemma 8 and Lemma 9 of proofs/paper/C05.md; EXP-C05-11 for the other 138 cases
the 57 cases are rebuilt by systems.magma_split.build and must match the SHA-256 hashes listed by EXP-C05-11

per-part checkpoints (EXP_CHECKPOINT) may be used to resume
falsification: A verified model (677 would have a model of order 12), a rejected proof, or a quasigroup part left UNKNOWN.
